methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for note-taking and knowledge apps was collected directly from each provider's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and recorded in USD. Each plan was independently re-verified on 2026-06-13 by fetching the provider's live pricing page; only providers whose prices/discounts/limits could be confirmed on a real provider-controlled page are retained. Where a provider prices per seat/user/editor, monthlyUsd records that per-unit list price with billingModel per_seat and the annual-vs-monthly rates noted in the plan notes; flat-priced or per-account/per-site tiers record the flat monthly fee with billingModel flat. Quote-only / contact-sales / Enterprise tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, and HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null unless a provider states otherwise. Providers whose pricing pages render figures only client-side (no price visible in the served page) and could not be corroborated on a real provider page were dropped rather than retained on an unverifiable guess: Evernote, Coda, Capacities and Roam Research were dropped on this pass for that reason (Roam additionally showed conflicting third-party annual rates).

vendors.name: Notion
vendors.provenance: Prices read from notion.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Live page rendered per-member figures (Free 0, Plus 9.50, Business 19.50, Enterprise custom) and a stated annual saving of up to 20%; the page localizes the currency symbol but the numeric per-member values are currency-neutral and match.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for individuals. Trial AI capabilities, basic forms, basic sites, Notion Calendar and Notion Mail, databases with subtasks and dependencies. Limits: up to 5MB file uploads, 7-day page history, max 10 external guests, limited blocks for workspaces with 2+ members.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 9.50 per member/mo at the annual-billing rate (page states up to 20% off vs monthly). Everything in Free plus custom forms, custom sites, unlimited charts, unlimited collaborative blocks, unlimited file uploads, basic connections, 30-day page history.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 19.50 per member/mo at the annual-billing rate (labeled Recommended; page states up to 20% off vs monthly). Adds Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search, SAML SSO, granular database permissions, private teamspaces, premium connections, 90-day page history.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom / quote-only (contact sales). Adds zero data retention with LLM providers, SCIM provisioning, advanced security controls, audit logs, dedicated customer success manager, DLP/SIEM connections, domain management.

limits: Free: 5 MB max file upload per file
Free: limited collaborative blocks for workspaces with 2+ members
Free: AI on trial basis only
keyFeatures: Flexible databases (tables, boards, calendars, galleries, timelines)
Notion AI (doc generation, autofill, meeting notes)
bestFor: Solo knowledge workers wanting free tier
enrichment.provenance: Compliance (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR) confirmed from notion.com/security on 2026-06-15. HIPAA applies to Enterprise plan users leveraging enterprise-grade security features. Integration list sourced from notion.com/integrations. Free tier limits from notion.com/pricing.

vendors.name: Obsidian
vendors.provenance: Prices read from obsidian.md/pricing on 2026-06-13. Live page rendered Sync $5/mo monthly and $4/mo annual, Publish $10/site/mo monthly and $8/site/mo annual, and a Commercial license at $50 USD per user per year; all figures confirmed verbatim on the served page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: The Obsidian app itself is free for personal use with no sign-up and no limitations. Sync and Publish are paid add-ons (separate plans below).

plans.name: Sync
plans.notes: $5 USD per user/mo billed monthly; $4 USD per user/mo billed annually. Cross-device syncing, end-to-end encryption, version history, shared-vault collaboration, priority support.

plans.name: Publish
plans.notes: $10 USD per site/mo billed monthly; $8 USD per site/mo billed annually (priced per published site, not per user). Web publishing with no technical knowledge required, customizable themes, graph and full-text search, priority support.

plans.name: Commercial license
plans.notes: Required for using Obsidian for work at companies of 2+ people. Priced at $50 USD per user per year (annual-only, no monthly option), so monthlyUsd is null; development support, featured organization status, bulk purchase available.

limits: Free app: local storage only, no cross-device sync (Sync add-on required)
Free app: no web publishing (Publish add-on required)
Sync: version history included but retention period not specified on pricing page
Publish: priced per site, not per user
Commercial license required for company use (2+ employees)
keyFeatures: Local-first Markdown files stored on device (no vendor lock-in)
Web publishing via Obsidian Publish (custom domains, full-text search, graph)
No account required for core app
Regular third-party security audits (Cure53, Trail of Bits)
enrichment.provenance: No HIPAA, SOC 2, or GDPR certifications mentioned on obsidian.md/security (2026-06-15). Security page confirms AES-256 encryption for Sync and third-party audits by Cure53 and Trail of Bits. Plugin ecosystem confirmed via obsidian.md pricing and about pages. Compliance fields set to null — no certification claims found.

vendors.name: Craft
vendors.provenance: USD list prices and limits read from the Craft Help Center 'Subscription Plans and Pricing' article on 2026-06-13, which served the figures as plain USD: Free, Plus $10/mo ($96/yr), Family $18/mo ($180/yr), Team $60/mo ($600/yr), with matching block/storage/AI-credit limits. The marketing pricing page (craft.do/pricing) localizes to non-USD currency, so the help-center article is the primary USD source.

plans.name: Starter (Free)
plans.notes: Free for 1 account. Up to 1,500 content blocks, 1GB storage, 25MB file uploads, 7-day version history, 15 AI credits per month.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $10/mo per account on monthly billing; $96/year (~$8/mo) billed annually. Unlimited documents, up to 5 spaces, 1TB per space, 5GB file uploads, 30-day version history, 50 AI credits/mo, custom domains.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: $18/mo total on monthly billing; $180/year (~$15/mo) billed annually. Bundled plan for up to 5 members, all Plus benefits per member, up to 5 shared family spaces, each member gets 5 personal spaces with 1TB.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $60/mo total on monthly billing; $600/year (~$50/mo) billed annually. Bundled plan for up to 10 members, all Plus benefits per member, up to 25 shared team spaces, each member gets 5 personal spaces with 1TB.

keyFeatures: Unified docs, tasks, calendar, and whiteboards in one app
MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI clients
Deep Apple platform integration (Mac App of the Year)
Data encryption at rest and in transit
Continuous vulnerability scanning and third-party penetration tests
enrichment.provenance: SOC 2 and GDPR confirmed as explicit section headings on craft.do/security (2026-06-15). HIPAA not mentioned — set to false. MCP integrations and feature list from craft.do homepage (2026-06-15). Free tier limits from Craft Help Center pricing article.

vendors.name: Bear
vendors.provenance: Prices read from the bear.app FAQ 'Features and price of Bear Pro' on 2026-06-13, which served $2.99/mo and $29.99/year with a 14-day free trial verbatim.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier offers Markdown editing, full tag system and the core writing experience on a single device. Cloud sync, encryption and premium features require Bear Pro.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $2.99/mo or $29.99/year (~$2.50/mo) for new customers, single subscription covers all Apple devices on the same Apple ID. Unlocks iCloud sync, note encryption and app lock, advanced export (PDF/HTML/DOCX/JPG), 20+ themes, app-icon choices, OCR search. 14-day free trial.

Free: no note encryption or app lock
Free: no advanced export (PDF, HTML, DOCX, JPG)
Pro: all Apple devices on same Apple ID
Billing handled by Apple (in-app purchase only)
keyFeatures: Focused Markdown editor with rich text shortcuts
Nested tag system with 250+ tag icons
OCR search in PDFs and images (Pro)
Individual note encryption and app lock (Pro)
Export to TXT, Markdown, TextBundle, RTF, PDF, JPG, HTML, DOCX, ePub
bestFor: Writers and minimalists on Apple devices

Free trial confirmed as 7 days from bear.app FAQ page (2026-06-15); note the original plan provenance stated 14 days — current FAQ page states 7 days.
